g.text: Equal nominal supply, different arrival patterns
Campaign 020: all 60 worlds. Movement and birth charges are zero; six treatments per matched seed.
Nominal mean is 0.06 per site-tick. Capacity truncation means realized supply need not match.
Finite-horizon outcomes do not establish permanent survival or a unique causal mediator.
